title: Electron-doped MoS2: superconducting dome and the 1x1 to 2x2 CDW transition

decision_points.fork: How to estimate Tc at the withheld dopings, given that lambda_FA jumps from 0.77 (0.14) to 1.41 (0.16)
decision_points.wrong_choice: Interpolate neighbouring Tc linearly, or average neighbouring spectra without rescaling to the tabulated lambda
decision_points.kind: regime found in the data; discriminating purchase (moments table)

decision_points.fork: Which spectra: adiabatic, NA (shifts) or FA (shifts + linewidths)
decision_points.wrong_choice: NA spectra (the paper's Fig. 2d level) or adiabatic spectra

decision_points.fork: Constant vs energy-dependent DOS for the 1x1 H phase
decision_points.wrong_choice: Constant-DOS Eliashberg (cheaper to reason about; ignores the Q-valley edge and the shift of mu at low T)

decision_points.fork: Allen-Dynes / McMillan vs Eliashberg at lambda > 1.5
decision_points.wrong_choice: Allen-Dynes formula from lambda, omega_log, omega_2

decision_points.fork: Which criterion marks the end of the 1x1 H ground state: PES energy crossing, 1x1 soft-mode instability or CDW lower stability edge
decision_points.wrong_choice: Imaginary Gamma* (M) soft mode of the 1x1 phase (x = 0.2029) or the lower edge of the CDW branch (0.1850)
decision_points.consequence: x_c off by +0.014 / -0.004; cascades into the SOC maximum (+28% / -7.9%)
decision_points.kind: regime judgement; coexistence and hysteresis found in the data; cascade

decision_points.fork: Doping units: PES labelled by tot_charge of the 2x2 cell; soft-mode and hysteresis tables in 10^14 cm^-2
decision_points.wrong_choice: Report the 2x2-cell charge (or the areal density) as x_c

decision_points.fork: Whether the ground-state maximum includes spin-orbit coupling (SOC spectra exist only at 0.18 and 0.19)
Dopings of the archive spectra 2x2cdw_dop1-3, which carry no doping; the paper caption quotes n1 = 3.0, n2 = 4.3, n3 = 4.6 x 10^14 cm^-2
decision_points.wrong_choice: Trust the caption, or assign dop1-3 to the first three rows of the authors' table
decision_points.kind: label inconsistency found by a cross-check (Allen-Dynes of the spectra vs the archived table)

decision_points.fork: What the archived Tc tables are: their header says only "Tc"; they are Allen-Dynes values (and their 1x1 A/NA columns do not match the archived A/NA spectra)
decision_points.wrong_choice: Use the archived tables as Eliashberg Tc (interpolating the 1x1 table; reading the CDW table at 1.4/1.6)
decision_points.kind: metadata inconsistency found by a cross-check

length_estimate.catalog_cost_note: retrievals only; every Eliashberg run costs 2 more

runtime_dependencies: numpy, scipy (runtime image); the lab runs eliashberg.py (numpy/scipy only)

data_provenance.not_used: fig6.tar.gz (elphmod model III, shared with the excluded Schobert 2024 study), figS11.tar.gz

solver_validation.against: archived fig2e/tc_*.dat (MM, AD, CE, CA, DE, DA at mu* = 0-0.20)

notes: Dome maximum and its doping (design target 3) are not graded: the archived 2x2 CDW Tc in the coexistence window are Allen-Dynes values without spectra, slightly above the 1x1 values, and the paper's headline 34.6 K (1x1 at 0.20, Allen-Dynes) would pass any such check by recall. The graded SOC maximum of the 1x1 ground-state branch replaces it.

tc_1x1_K (relative, tolerance 3%).gray_zone_note: one neighbour's spectral shape rescaled to the tabulated lambda ignores the tabulated omega_log; not defensible, not graded as a wrong path

tc_cdw_high_K (relative, tolerance 4%).robustness: direct lab output once the labels are assigned (spread < 0.1%)
